newsitem.title: USA: U.S. DLA delays cobalt tender announcment.
newsitem.headline: U.S. DLA delays cobalt tender announcment.

text.p: The U.S. Defense Logistics Agency said it was delaying giving results of its cobalt tender until Wednesday due to a technical concern.

The agency was examining one of the bids to see if it was in the correct format, stockpile spokesman Peter Roman said. "We are deciding if one of the bids drops out or not," he said. He declined to say which bid was in question.
The agency offered 1,000,000 pounds of surplus cobalt for sale in its sealed-bid format, with ten firms submitting bids Monday.
No time was given for the Wednesday announcement.
The agency had previously said it planned to announce the results Tuesday.
